buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Scope of Supply Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components) : Only supply of Goods 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. Preferable manufacturer should participate. Participating traders/agents must provide authorization lett er issued by the OEM. Authorization letter should be tender/Bid specific. Bidders must submit valid authori zation letter containing the required information along with their offer failing which the offer is liable to be ignored. 2. For placement of order, the OEM [Principal Firm] directly or through authorized dealers shall have succe ssfully executed a contract for supply of Computer and Printer to any Govt organization/PSU/PPP Project of minimum 10 percent of the advertised value of the bid [Bid Value – 333440.00] during previous 3 years. Th is period of 3 years shall be counted with respect to date of tender closing. In this regard, Firms should su bmit a past performance document in the form of CRN/CRAC/R-NOTE/completion certificate issued by com petent authority of that Govt organization/PSU/PPP Project along with PO. Failure to submit documentary e vidence will imply that firm has no such performance and Railways reserves the right to disqualify the offe r. In case tenderer participates as an authorized agent, then the past performance as required above shall be that of the principal, authorizing the agent. It may so happen that the agent has credentials of past sup ply for a different Principal, but these will not be considered as performance for placing the order in case of change of Principal. 3. Railway reserves the right to ignore offer of any such bidder who has faced cancellation/termination of contract with imposition of penalty/incident on account of unsatisfactory performance/execution of contrac t of any equivalent services/goods during the past 12 months. This period of 12 months shall be counted w it h respect to date of tender closing. 4. Railway reserves the right to validate authenticity of any document submitted by the bidder from its iss uing authority. Contact details [Name/Designation/Official email/Mobile no.] of the issuing authority must b e provided by the bidder if asked for, failing which Railways reserves the right to disqualify the offer.

5. Contract shall be governed by IRS conditions. 6. Material Transportation, handling and unloading is in the scope of supplier. 7. Bidder must provide undertaking that the supplying product full fill all the technical specification given i n ATC. . 3.
